thread:
Aisha (Partnerships): Quick sync — want to lock the Systems Integrator "Pathfinder" onboarding flow for marketplace listing + joint announcement. High level: training curriculum, hardware compatibility checklist, certification badge + automated issuance. Thoughts?

Raj (Solutions): Two tracks IMO: 1) Integrator engineer — deep hands-on labs, exam. 2) Sales/AE — product positioning + pricing & contract checklist. Each track should be ~2hrs + a short verification exercise.

Marta (DevEx): Agreed. Hands-on labs should be runnable in a disposable sandbox (cloud project + shortlived creds). Prefer infra-as-code examples (Terraform + k8s manifest). We can reuse the si-labs repo: https://github.com/redwood/si-labs (w/ tiny edits).

Owen (Partner Eng): Hardware partners will want a "Compatibility Verified" badge. Suggest acceptance criteria: perf (target 99th %ile latency), memory footprint, and a published AMI/container image with repro steps. I'll draft a checklist today.

Kelsey (Marketing): For comms, recommend phased approach: partner-only co-marketing -> marketplace listing -> joint public blog + socials. Need partner logo + legal signoff earlier. Who's owning timeline? :eyes: :tempo:rocket: 

Aisha (Partnerships): Targeting a two-week runway after cert completion. Draft timeline: cert cutoff 2025-11-10 -> marketplace + co-marketing 2025-11-24. Is that realistic?

Raj (Solutions): Tight but doable if training modules, labs, and exam are ready by 2025-11-03. I can pull exam Qs from the lab exercises.

Marta (DevEx): I'll scope two lab modules this sprint (inference runtime + deployment on Dedicated). ETA: module drafts by 2025-11-02.

Owen (Partner Eng): I'll open the hardware checklist PR now. Need to include test commands and perf harness. Also want to loop in hw-partners channel.

Kelsey (Marketing): I'll mock announcement copy and marketplace listing template by EOD tomorrow. Will need logo files and co-marketing language. @Legal please advise on required wording.

Legal: Please drop final logo assets and any co-marketing language for review at least 7 days prior to public announce. We'll also need partner trademark approvals.

integrations-bot: PR opened by Owen: https://github.com/redwood/partner-checklists/pull/452 — title: "hardware-compatibility-checklist + perf harness" :white_check_mark:

Aisha (Partnerships): Plan + owners: Training/exam = Raj; Labs/sandbox = Marta + Sam (EngInfra); Hardware checklist = Owen; Comms + marketplace listing = Kelsey. I'll own the playbook page in the partner portal and wire the issuance flow for badges. Anyone want to be co-owner on playbook?

Raj (Solutions): I'll co-own the playbook section for training + exam content. Also +1 for automated badge issuance (API-based).

Marta (DevEx): I'll work with Sam to provision sandbox projects and CI for lab resets. @Sam (EngInfra) can you confirm available quota and timeframe?

Sam (EngInfra): We can provision ephemeral sandbox projects. Need spec for concurrent sandboxes and cleanup TTL. I'll sync with Marta offline.

Owen (Partner Eng): I'll ping our top 3 HW partners and ask for a short compatibility run (script + expected outputs). Will share consolidated results in a spreadsheet.

Kelsey (Marketing): Draft timeline: 
- 11/02: Labs ready (draft)
- 11/03: Exam + training content locked
- 11/05: Hardware checklist PR merged
- 11/10: Certification cutoff (final QA)
- 11/17: Partner-only co-marketing sent
- 11/24: Public marketplace listing + blog
I'll adjust if folks hit blockers.

Aisha (Partnerships): Splitting next steps into short action items so we don't lose momentum: 
1) Owen — final checklist PR + perf harness (owner)
2) Marta & Sam — sandbox infra + two lab modules (owner)
3) Raj — exam questions and training slides (owner)
4) Kelsey — draft comms and marketplace listing template (owner)
5) Legal — logo & co-marketing review timeline (owner)
6) Aisha — assemble partner portal playbook and badge automation flow (owner)

Marta (DevEx): I'll post initial lab scafold here once created.

Raj (Solutions): Will provide draft exam rubric and pass/fail criteria.

Kelsey (Marketing): I'll also prepare a one-pager for partner launch approvals.

Aisha (Partnerships): Awesome — thanks team. If nobody objects I'll lock the timeline tomorrow morning and start outreach to partners. :rocket: 

Owen (Partner Eng): 👍 I'll update PR and tag hw partners.

Legal: Noted — share assets by 11/16 latest.
